question: Could you tell me the first names of customers who spent less than $1 on albums by the best-selling artist, along with the amounts they spent?
sql:
SELECT 
    c.FirstName,
    SUM(i.UnitPrice * i.Quantity) AS AmountSpent
FROM invoice_items i
JOIN tracks t ON i.TrackId = t.TrackId
JOIN albums al ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId
JOIN customers c ON i.InvoiceId = c.CustomerId
WHERE al.ArtistId = 90
GROUP BY c.FirstName
HAVING SUM(i.UnitPrice * i.Quantity) < 1.0
ORDER BY c.FirstName, AmountSpent
